description: SEC 10-K regulation profile — How regulated is a public company? Reads the Government Regulation sections of the latest 10-K (Item 1; falls back to regulation sentences in Items 1 and 1A) and returns the regulators named (FDA, FTC, EPA, FCC, Federal Reserve, European Commission...), laws cited (GDPR, CCPA, FCPA, HIPAA, Dodd-Frank, EU DMA/DSA...), regulation themes ranked by mentions, jurisdictions, compliance-cost sentences with dollar amounts, pending or new rules, key sentences and a HEAVY/MODERATE/LIGHT burden heuristic. ticker= required; optional filing=1 for the prior 10-K. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_regulation
